description.narrative: (Tanzania): &amp;amp;lt;!--td {border: 1px solid #ccc;}br {mso-data-placement:same-cell;}--&amp;amp;gt;With FY 2021 funds, this activity will continue to implement social and behavioral change (SBC) interventions at multiple levels in order to create demand for and awareness of health services among Tanzanians, with a particular focus on changing behaviors surrounding maternal, newborn, and child health, family planning, malaria, HIV, tuberculosis, and other emerging infectious diseases. Specifically, Tulonge Afya, by developing and tailoring messages to geographic, epidemiological, and audience segments, aims to: (1) improve the ability of individuals to practice healthy behaviors at the household level; (2) strengthen and scale up community support for sustained changes in health behaviors; (3) improve systems for SBC coordination at national, regional, and district levels; and (4) implement national SBC through integrated platforms developed by this activity as well as stand-alone HIV campaigns that address particular and targeted needs of PLHIV and those at higher risk of HIV..... .
